skills.name: Negotiate a purchase
skills.description: Describe an item, then exchange integer offers in credits. Standard opening-price caps: lamp 110, chair 198, bookshelf 286. An optional RPS rock/paper/scissors message after selection can discount a quote to its minimum. Losing or drawing never raises the quote; numeric negotiation does not require a game. A signed receipt records exactly the agreed price; no added fees.
